Name: Mizu's Capybara Chinese Translation
Author: guzhisusu
Description:
Simplified Chinese Translation for the original animal mod. This mod only contains translation text files, no original mod assets. You need to download and install the original mod first to use this translation.
[list=1]
Download and install the original mod first.  [/list][list=1]
Extract this translation zip archive. [/list][list=1]
Place the translation files into your mod folder.[/list][list=1]
Launch the game. Full Simplified Chinese localization for texts of the animal mod. [/list][list=1]
Translate in‑game messages, item names, dialogue and related content to Simplified Chinese.[/list][list=1]
 ‑ Original mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46817) ‑ Stardew Valley latest version ‑ SMAPI is required[/list][list=1]
Huge thanks to the original mod author for making this wonderful animal mod. [/list][list=1]
Thanks for allowing translation work. [/list][list=1]
Translation completed by [guzhisusu].[/list]
